description: Windows real-app semantic action verification fixture for SpectrAI Claw Computer Use provider.

preflightChecklist.name: UIA availability
preflightChecklist.expectation: listWindows returns at least one visible window and readTree returns ElementNode roots for native system apps.

preflightChecklist.name: Win32 semantic fallback
preflightChecklist.expectation: HWND-backed Button/Edit controls expose nativeWindowHandle so BM_CLICK or WM_SETTEXT can be attempted when UIA Pattern is absent.

preflightChecklist.name: IAccessible wake
preflightChecklist.expectation: Chromium/Electron windows can be awakened through AccessibleObjectFromWindow before declaring vision fallback.

preflightChecklist.name: Foreground/HID fallback is explicit
preflightChecklist.expectation: Foreground-only actions report requiresForeground=true or fallbackUsed=hid/foreground, never background success.

preflightChecklist.name: Permissions/session/RDP
preflightChecklist.expectation: Run in an unlocked interactive desktop session with matching integrity level; record RDP/lock-screen state.

scenarios.notes: Read-only session inventory. This is the first canary for UIA/Win32 provider availability.

assertions: at least one node exposes patterns or nativeWindowHandle for system apps
scenarios.notes: Use depth 4 first; increase to 6 only for diagnosis to avoid oversized UIA trees.

assertions: selector returns exactly one best-scored ElementNode or records ambiguity
ElementNode has stable automationId/name/controlType/path/bounds where available
scenarios.notes: AutomationId can differ by Windows version; selector should fall back to name/controlType/path rather than raw coordinates.

assertions: post-action tree/display read can observe calculator result text when available
scenarios.notes: Calculator UIA automationIds are stable on many Windows versions but localized names vary; prefer automationId when present.

assertions: verification.passed is true or failure maps to requires_foreground/capability
scenarios.notes: Modern Notepad may use a custom text surface; if ValuePattern is absent and WM_SETTEXT is rejected, report requires_foreground and use legacy keyboard_type fallback.

assertions: findElement returns a filesystem/navigation item or records localized-name mismatch
select/focus action verifies IsSelected or HasKeyboardFocus when UIA exposes state
if foreground is needed, failure code is requires_foreground instead of hid success
scenarios.notes: Explorer labels are localized and can be virtualized; selector should allow equivalent system app items and avoid coordinate-only targeting.

troubleshooting.symptom: UIA tree is empty or only desktop root is returned
likelyCauses: target app runs elevated while provider is not
app is Chromium/Electron and accessibility tree has not been awakened
recommendedActions: allow IAccessible wake before vision fallback
record ambiguity and avoid raw coordinate click

troubleshooting.symptom: Win32 BM_CLICK or WM_SETTEXT does not change the app
recommendedActions: use foreground keyboard_type only as explicit fallback

troubleshooting.symptom: Action needs foreground even though element was found
recommendedActions: focus window through old window_focus path

likelyCauses: window moved between screenshot and click
recommendedActions: re-capture screenshot immediately before HID fallback
mark environment as unsupported for HID/vision
do not claim action success without verification
